title: Multifractal gradient-scaling break (Gaussian-scale log-log slope + curvature of RTP, isostatic gravity and detrended topography) as zero-catalogue channels on the organizer 19-band stack, hide-and-recover LightGBM, H33-matched two-regime dotted emission
pre_compute_wording_correction: Hypothesis decay-direction sentence corrected at 13:34Z after synthetic measurement (step slope -0.85, ramp 0, noise -1.52), before any feature/holdout/production computation; statistic, arms, budgets and gates unchanged.
hypothesis: A blind or cover-obscured fault is a near-discontinuity in crustal properties: its smoothed gradient peak decays with the distinct ~1/sigma exponent of a discontinuity (measured synthetic slope -0.85) while remaining localised on the trace, whereas smooth lithologic/regional gradients are scale-free (slope ~0) and incoherent noise decays faster (~ -1.5). The per-pixel log-log slope and scaling break (curvature) of gradient magnitude across Gaussian scales sigma in {1,2,4} px therefore rank concealed fault traces that single-scale gradient, tilt and upward-continuation worm amplitudes miss, including beneath low-relief basin cover where no scarp is mapped.
mechanism: For RTP magnetics (band 2), isostatic gravity (band 13) and detrended elevation (band 12): G_sigma = |grad(field smoothed at sigma)|; slope = 0.721348*(log G_4 - log G_1) (exact least-squares slope for log-spaced scales 1,2,4); break = log G_2 - (log G_1 + log G_4)/2. Gradient floor eps = 0.01 * footprint-median(G_1). Slope clipped to [-3,1], break to [-2,2]. Six channels appended to the 19 organizer bands; LightGBM PU ranker recovers withheld catalogue components; dots emitted in two distance regimes (60% at 3 < d_visible <= 25 px, 40% at d_visible > 25 px) at >= 2.8 px spacing outside a 3 px collar, matching the measured H33 emission economics (37,654 binary dots, share_le2 = 0, share_gt25 = 0.417, median d_cat 19.65 px).
named_non_fault_mimics: Unfaulted lithologic contacts (intrusive/volcanic margins) with sharp density/magnetization steps: same slow gradient decay without brittle offset
Pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline benches and terrace risers: persistent topographic edges at constant elevation
GeoDAWN flight-line levelling seams: linear scale-persistent artefacts in magnetic derivatives
Range-front bedrock-alluvium contacts without Quaternary faulting
catalogue_features: NONE in the feature matrix. The catalogue enters only (a) training labels, (b) the 3 px emission collar, (c) the two-regime distance split computed from the VISIBLE catalogue only inside each holdout fold (full catalogue only for the final production fingerprint).
difference_from_repo_lanes: BPWD/PSGV computed a Fourier upward-continuation log-ratio hg(200m)/hg(2800m) of RTP horizontal gradient multiplied by gravity HG (psgv_curie_spectral_shallow). GTHC/MTAS/PHASE used continuation amplitudes, cross-scale admittance differences and angular discordance. No lane in src/gems88 computes a per-pixel Gaussian-scale log-log gradient-decay slope AND scaling-break curvature jointly on magnetics, gravity and topography. No lane froze a 60/40 two-regime emission matched to the measured H33 distance fingerprint for BOTH holdout arms.

evaluator.name: gems57-pooled-hide-v2
evaluator.folds: holdout.buffered_component_draw(seed in {20,21}, hide_frac=0.20, buffer_px=3, boundary_px=12); leave-one-quadrant-out training on visible catalogue
evaluator.scoring: pooled DTI alpha=0.2 beta=0.8 300 m triangular kernel; visible catalogue pixel-exactly masked; subsets far (>10 px from visible) and blind (>25 px)
evaluator.bootstrap: paired physical 20 km block percentile, 1000 draws, seed 520810 (+stratum index)

experiments.what: single-feature leakage canary for all 25 features (symmetric AUC <= 0.90) on withheld positives vs sampled negatives
experiments.decision: stop with no emission if any feature exceeds 0.90

experiments.what: 8-cell holdout arm A (19+MFS, 25ch) vs arm B (19ch), identical LightGBM, seeds, budgets and two-regime emitter; fold budget = 37654 x region_cells / 5167373
experiments.decision: lane_pass iff paired delta (A-B) 95% CI excludes 0 from above on pooled overall AND far>10 px

experiments.what: production fit of arm A on the full visible catalogue; 37,654 dots; two-phase uniqueness (production surface Spearman before placement, final-dot overlap after); shared submission writer (zeros mode); independent validator
experiments.decision: research TIFF is always written DO-NOT-SUBMIT unless every promotion gate below passes

promotion_gates.lane_pass: EXP2 paired CI > 0 on overall and far

uniqueness_corrected.note: dot-field rasters bind on positive cells; dense rasters (>10% footprint positive) bind on top-k (k=our dots) and top-2% cells, worse binding; literal overlap vs every raster is also computed and published

uniqueness_literal.expected_result: FAIL by construction vs the space-filling 17GEMSDOE witness (positive on 5,167,373/5,167,373 footprint cells; seeded random dots also score 1.0, re-verified 2026-10-25 this session). While the literal rule stands unamended by the portfolio selector, ok_to_submit=false and verdict=negative regardless of other gates.

promotion_gates.format: single-band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, transform (100,0,243350,0,-100,4508550), all finite in [0,1], nodata unset, 0 outside footprint and on catalogue (shared submission_writer, zeros mode)
